proxy_restarted.title: Proxy Restarted
proxy_restarted.body: Session stats live in the proxy's memory. If the process restarted, counters reset to 0 even though nothing is wrong.

near_limit_warnings.title: Near-Limit Warnings
near_limit_warnings.body: Fires when a budget or provider quota window crosses 80/90/100% utilization. Dismiss to hide until the next new threshold is crossed. Enable native OS notifications in Settings.

live_feed.title: Live Feed
live_feed.body: Every request the proxy has handled recently, newest first, showing what Headroom compressed away.

count.title: Count
count.body: Number of recent requests currently loaded in the feed.

new_messages.title: New messages
new_messages.body: Click to jump to the newest message and resume auto-scrolling (Follow).

savings.title: Savings
savings.body: Tokens Headroom removed from this request and the resulting percentage reduction.

transforms_applied.title: Transforms applied
transforms_applied.body: The compression transforms Headroom ran on this request, in order.

before.title: Before
before.body: The original prompt exactly as sent to Headroom, before any compression.

after.title: After
after.body: What Headroom actually sent upstream to the provider after compression.

no_changes.title: No changes detected
no_changes.body: The input and the output are byte-identical and uncompressed for this request -- nothing was rewritten, so there's no before/after diff to show.

headroom.title: Headroom
headroom.body: Headroom is a local proxy that compresses prompts before they reach the model, cutting token cost and context bloat. This dashboard reports what it saved.

version.title: Version
version.body: The running Headroom proxy version, reported by the /health endpoint.

last_update.title: Last update
last_update.body: Wall-clock time of the last successful stats poll from your browser.

proxy_uptime.title: Proxy uptime
proxy_uptime.body: How long the Headroom proxy process has been running, ticking live between /health polls.

session_view.title: Session view
session_view.body: Live stats for the current proxy process: savings, throughput, agents, and recent requests since it started.

historical_view.title: Historical view
historical_view.body: Persisted savings across restarts, rolled up daily, weekly, and monthly.

mcp_view.title: MCP view
mcp_view.body: Usage stats for MCP tool calls proxied through Headroom.

anonymous_telemetry.title: Anonymous telemetry
anonymous_telemetry.body: Anonymous aggregate telemetry is enabled. Disable with HEADROOM_TELEMETRY=off or --no-telemetry.

github.title: GitHub
github.body: Open the Headroom source repository on GitHub in a new tab.

report_an_issue.title: Report an issue
report_an_issue.body: Open a new GitHub issue to report a bug or request a feature.

mcp_dashboards.title: MCP Dashboards
mcp_dashboards.body: Open the web dashboards of installed MCP servers Headroom detected. The dot shows whether each server is currently reachable.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Configure poll intervals, savings profile and budget, token pricing overrides, and which panes/tabs are shown.

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Toggle light/dark mode. Your choice is remembered in this browser.

overhead.title: Overhead
overhead.body: Extra latency the proxy adds per request while compressing. Lower is better; this is the cost you pay for the token savings above. Also shows average TTFB (time to first byte).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Near-limit warnings for budgets and provider quota windows (Anthropic, Codex, Copilot). Fires at 80/90/100% utilization. Dismiss individually or all at once; re-appears when a new threshold is crossed.

active_profile.title: Active profile
active_profile.body: Current proxy savings profile: {value}. Sets how aggressively prompts are compressed.

live_feed_toggle_on.title: Live Feed
live_feed_toggle_on.body: Open the live drawer of message transformations to inspect what the proxy rewrote per request.

live_feed_toggle_off.title: Live Feed
live_feed_toggle_off.body: Open the live drawer of transformation events. Start the proxy with --log-messages (or HEADROOM_LOG_MESSAGES=true) to also see full request/response bodies here.

mcp_dashboard_unavailable.title: MCP server
mcp_dashboard_unavailable.body: This MCP server is not reachable — is it running?

proxy_healthy.title: Proxy healthy
proxy_healthy.body: The proxy answered /health and /stats normally on the last poll.

proxy_error.title: Proxy error
proxy_error.body: The last poll to the proxy failed.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Headline results for this session: money and tokens saved, agent usage, and the savings breakdown.

get_started.title: Get Started
get_started.body: Headroom hasn't seen any traffic yet. Point your client at the proxy or run a learn pass to get started.

proxy_saved.title: Proxy $ Saved
proxy_saved.body: Estimated money saved by the proxy compressing tool outputs before they reach the model, priced at the model's list input rate. Compression only — excludes cache and other effects.

token_savings.title: Token Savings
token_savings.body: Total input tokens removed by compression, and the percentage that represents of what was compressed: how much smaller the prompt got after the proxy shrank tool outputs, versus the original size.

of_total_wire.title: Of total wire
of_total_wire.body: Savings as a fraction of all input tokens actually sent, including the frozen (uncompressible) prefix.

output_tokens_saved.title: Output Tokens Saved
output_tokens_saved.body: Fewer output tokens the model generated because prompts were compressed, measured against a holdout baseline (counterfactual). 'measured' = A/B holdout; 'estimated' = vs a learned baseline.

95_confidence_interval.title: 95% confidence interval
95_confidence_interval.body: The range the true output reduction percentage is likely to fall in, given the sample of shaped responses measured so far.

overhead.title: Overhead
overhead.body: Extra latency the proxy adds per request while compressing. Lower is better; this is the cost you pay for the token savings above.

throughput.title: Throughput
throughput.body: Token processing rates across the proxy pipeline, in tokens/second. p50/p95 are the median and 95th-percentile over a rolling window.

input_throughput.title: Input throughput
input_throughput.body: Rate the proxy ingests input tokens. Wall-clock counts total elapsed time; active p50 is the median rate over just the busy processing time.

compression_throughput.title: Compression throughput
compression_throughput.body: How fast the compression stage processes tokens (median / 95th percentile). Higher means compression adds less delay.

forward_throughput.title: Forward throughput
forward_throughput.body: Rate tokens are forwarded upstream to the provider (median / 95th percentile), after compression.

generation_throughput.title: Generation throughput
generation_throughput.body: Rate the model streams output tokens back (median / 95th percentile). Reflects the provider's generation speed, not the proxy's.

current_5m_active_p50.title: Current 5m (active p50)
current_5m_active_p50.body: Median input and forward rates over just the last 5 minutes of active processing — a near-real-time snapshot versus the longer rolling window above.

budget.title: Budget
budget.body: Spend against the configured budget for the current period. Set a budget limit in Settings to enable this.

agent_usage.title: Agent Usage
agent_usage.body: Token usage before vs after compression, broken down by the client (Cursor, Claude, Codex, etc.) Headroom detected for each request.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.body: Share of requests that could be attributed to a known client. Low coverage means many requests arrived without a recognizable client fingerprint.

before.title: Before
before.body: Total input tokens across all agents as they arrived, before the proxy compressed anything.

after.title: After
after.body: Total input tokens actually forwarded upstream after compression.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Tokens removed by compression across all agents (Before minus After).

savings.title: Savings
savings.body: Saved as a percentage of Before tokens — the overall compression rate across all agents.

token_flow.title: Token flow
token_flow.body: Share of this agent's input tokens saved by compression versus how much was actually sent, shown as a proportional bar.

before_2.title: Before
before_2.body: This agent's input tokens as they arrived, before the proxy compressed anything.

after_2.title: After
after_2.body: This agent's input tokens actually forwarded upstream after compression.

saved_2.title: Saved
saved_2.body: Tokens removed by compression for this agent (Before minus After).

share.title: Share
share.body: This agent's share of all tokens saved across every detected client this session.

savings_breakdown.title: Savings Breakdown
savings_breakdown.body: Estimated dollar savings split by source: Headroom's own compression versus the provider's native prefix-cache discount.

compression.title: Compression
compression.body: Dollar value of tokens Headroom's compression removed before they were sent, priced at the model's list input rate.

prefix_cache_discount.title: Prefix Cache Discount
prefix_cache_discount.body: Dollar value saved from the provider's own prefix-cache read discount — separate from anything Headroom compressed.

output_reduction_measured.title: Measured
output_reduction_measured.body: 'Measured' comes from an A/B holdout comparing shaped vs unshaped responses; 'estimated' compares against a learned baseline instead, so it carries more uncertainty.

output_reduction_estimated.title: Estimated
output_reduction_estimated.body: 'Measured' comes from an A/B holdout comparing shaped vs unshaped responses; 'estimated' compares against a learned baseline instead, so it carries more uncertainty.

token_usage_providers_performance.title: Token Usage, Providers & Performance
token_usage_providers_performance.body: Where tokens went (before/after compression), which providers served traffic, proxy latency, and per-model savings.

token_usage.title: Token Usage
token_usage.body: Where input tokens went at each stage of the pipeline: what arrived, what was removed, and what was ultimately sent to the model.

before_compression.title: Before Compression
before_compression.body: Total input tokens as they arrived at the proxy, before any filtering or compression.

client_side_filtered.title: Client-side filtered
client_side_filtered.body: Tokens removed by client-side filtering (e.g. RTK) before the request reached the proxy. Not priced into proxy $ savings.

proxy_removed.title: Proxy Removed
proxy_removed.body: Input tokens the proxy itself compressed away — the component priced into Proxy $ Saved.

after_compression_sent.title: After Compression (sent)
after_compression_sent.body: Input tokens actually forwarded to the provider after all filtering and compression.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.body: Total tokens the model generated in responses across all requests this session.

providers.title: Providers
providers.body: Breakdown of traffic by upstream provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) that the proxy routed requests to.

performance.title: Performance
performance.body: Latency the proxy adds and how fast upstream responds, plus failure count.

headroom_overhead.title: Headroom Overhead
headroom_overhead.body: Average extra time the proxy spends per request on compression and processing. This is the latency cost of the savings.

overhead_range.title: Overhead Range
overhead_range.body: Minimum to maximum proxy overhead observed per request — shows how variable the added latency is.

ttfb_upstream.title: TTFB (upstream)
ttfb_upstream.body: Average time to first byte from the upstream provider — the model's own response latency, not the proxy's.

ttfb_range.title: TTFB Range
ttfb_range.body: Minimum to maximum upstream time-to-first-byte observed.

failed_requests.title: Failed Requests
failed_requests.body: Requests that errored (upstream error or proxy failure) this session.

pipeline_breakdown.title: Pipeline Breakdown
pipeline_breakdown.body: Average and max time spent in each named transform stage of the compression pipeline, per request.

per_model_token_savings.title: Per-Model Token Savings
per_model_token_savings.body: Exact tokens saved, sent, and requested per model, so you can see which models Headroom compresses best against.

model.title: Model
model.body: The model name reported on requests. Click to sort alphabetically.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: Number of requests sent to this model this session. Click to sort.

tokens_saved.title: Tokens Saved
tokens_saved.body: Input tokens removed by compression for requests to this model. Click to sort.

tokens_sent.title: Tokens Sent
tokens_sent.body: Input tokens actually forwarded to this model after compression. Click to sort.

reduction.title: Reduction %
reduction.body: Tokens saved divided by (tokens saved + tokens sent) for this model — how much smaller compressed requests are versus what they would have been uncompressed. Assumes the same request shape would have been sent without Headroom.

provider_breakdown.title: Provider breakdown
provider_breakdown.body: Requests routed to {value} this session, and its share of total request volume.

pipeline_stage.title: Pipeline stage
pipeline_stage.body: Time spent in the {value} pipeline stage: average and worst-case (max) milliseconds per request.

provider_windows_cache.title: Provider Windows & Cache
provider_windows_cache.body: Subscription/rate-limit windows for Anthropic, Codex, and Copilot, plus prefix-cache impact. Only cards with data appear.

provider_windows_cache_2.title: Provider Windows & Cache
provider_windows_cache_2.body: Subscription/quota windows (Anthropic 5h/7d, Codex rate limits, Copilot quota) and prefix-cache efficiency appear here once that provider's traffic flows through the proxy.

anthropic_subscription_window.title: Anthropic Subscription Window
anthropic_subscription_window.body: Utilization of your Anthropic subscription's rolling 5-hour and 7-day usage windows, reported by the last observed API response headers.

window_activity.title: Window activity
window_activity.body: Whether Headroom has seen Anthropic traffic recently enough to consider this subscription window active.

5_hour_window.title: 5-Hour Window
5_hour_window.body: Percent of your rolling 5-hour Anthropic usage allowance consumed. This window resets on a rolling basis, not at a fixed clock time.

7_day_window.title: 7-Day Window
7_day_window.body: Percent of your rolling 7-day Anthropic usage allowance consumed. Separate from the 5-hour window; either can bind you first depending on your plan.

extra_usage_overage.title: Extra Usage (Overage)
extra_usage_overage.body: Pay-as-you-go credits spent once your 5h/7d subscription windows are exhausted and overage billing kicks in.

headroom_contribution_this_window.title: Headroom Contribution This Window
headroom_contribution_this_window.body: How much of this Anthropic subscription window Headroom saved you by compressing prompts and hitting prefix cache before tokens were submitted.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.body: Share of tokens that would have been submitted without Headroom that were instead saved this window — higher means more of the window's budget was preserved.

tokens_saved.title: Tokens Saved
tokens_saved.body: Total tokens kept out of this subscription window by Headroom, combining compression and prefix-cache reads.

compression.title: Compression
compression.body: Tokens saved specifically by the proxy's compression of tool outputs, counted against this window.

cache_reads.title: Cache Reads
cache_reads.body: Tokens served from Anthropic's prefix cache instead of being freshly submitted, counted against this window.

raw_vs_submitted.title: Raw vs Submitted
raw_vs_submitted.body: Tokens actually forwarded to Anthropic against this window versus what would have been sent with Headroom disabled.

anomalies_detected.title: Anomalies Detected
anomalies_detected.body: Inconsistencies Headroom noticed between what Anthropic's headers reported and what it expected for this window — e.g. a utilization jump or reset time that doesn't line up with observed traffic.

openai_codex_rate_limit_window.title: OpenAI Codex Rate-Limit Window
openai_codex_rate_limit_window.body: Utilization of your Codex CLI/API rate-limit windows, parsed from the last observed OpenAI response headers.

primary_window.title: Primary Window
primary_window.body: Utilization of Codex's primary rate-limit window (the shorter of the two windows OpenAI reports).

secondary_window.title: Secondary Window
secondary_window.body: Utilization of Codex's secondary rate-limit window (typically the longer window OpenAI reports alongside the primary one).

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: Codex API credit balance available once your subscription rate-limit windows are exhausted.

github_copilot_quota.title: GitHub Copilot Quota
github_copilot_quota.body: Utilization of your Copilot plan's monthly Chat, Completions, and Premium Interaction quotas, reported by the last observed Copilot API response.

monthly_reset.title: Monthly Reset
monthly_reset.body: When Copilot's quota counters reset for the current billing month, and how far through the month you are.

prefix_cache_impact.title: Prefix Cache Impact
prefix_cache_impact.body: How much provider-native prompt caching (Anthropic/OpenAI prefix cache) saved this session, separate from Headroom's own compression.

cache_reads_2.title: Cache Reads
cache_reads_2.body: Input tokens served from the provider's prefix cache instead of being freshly processed, and the dollar amount saved from the discounted cache-read rate.

cache_writes.title: Cache Writes
cache_writes.body: Input tokens written into the provider's prefix cache for future reuse, and the extra cost of the write-premium rate charged for those tokens.

hit_rate.title: Hit Rate
hit_rate.body: Share of requests this session that hit the prefix cache at least partially, out of all requests observed.

cache_busts.title: Cache Busts
cache_busts.body: Number of times a previously cached prefix had to be rewritten because it changed or expired, and how many tokens that re-write cost.

providers.title: Providers
providers.body: Number of upstream providers that have reported prefix-cache data this session.

cache_efficiency.title: Cache Efficiency
cache_efficiency.body: Breakdown of input tokens this session between cache reads (discounted), cache writes (premium), and tokens that missed the cache entirely.

observed_ttl_buckets.title: Observed TTL Buckets
observed_ttl_buckets.body: How cache-write tokens split between the provider's 1-hour and 5-minute TTL buckets — a longer TTL costs more per write but survives idle time better.

1h_cache_writes.title: 1h Cache Writes
1h_cache_writes.body: Tokens written to the provider's 1-hour TTL cache bucket, and how many requests contributed to it.

5m_cache_writes.title: 5m Cache Writes
5m_cache_writes.body: Tokens written to the provider's 5-minute TTL cache bucket, and how many requests contributed to it.

saved_by_compression.title: Saved by Compression
saved_by_compression.body: Tokens Headroom's compression removed from prompts before they were sent, independent of caching.

lost_to_cache_busts.title: Lost to Cache Busts
lost_to_cache_busts.body: Tokens re-written into the cache because compression changed the prefix enough to invalidate a previously cached one.

net.title: Net
net.body: Tokens saved by compression minus tokens lost to compression-triggered cache busts — whether compression is a net win against this session's caching.

prefix_freeze_net.title: Prefix Freeze Net
prefix_freeze_net.body: Net tokens gained by freezing the compressible prefix to preserve cache hits, minus the compression opportunity given up to keep it frozen.

ttl_expiry.title: TTL Expiry
ttl_expiry.body: Requests that missed the cache because they arrived after the cached prefix's TTL had already lapsed. A longer TTL reduces this.

prefix_change.title: Prefix Change
prefix_change.body: Requests that missed the cache because the cacheable prefix itself changed (e.g. compression or edited system prompt) before the TTL expired.

unknown.title: Unknown
unknown.body: Cache misses where the prefix looked stable and the TTL hadn't expired — Headroom couldn't attribute a cause.

total_misses.title: Total Misses
total_misses.body: Total requests that expected a prefix-cache hit but did not get one, across all attribution reasons.

per_provider_breakdown.title: Per-Provider Breakdown
per_provider_breakdown.body: Cache reads, writes, and TTL mix broken out by upstream provider, since each provider prices and expires prefix caching differently.

copilot_category.title: Copilot quota category
copilot_category.body: Copilot {value} quota usage for the current billing month. Unlimited categories never block; otherwise Headroom shows used / entitlement and remaining allowance.

prefix_cache_provider.title: Provider prefix-cache activity
prefix_cache_provider.body: Prefix-cache activity reported by {label}: reads at a {read_discount} discount{write_suffix}.

recent_requests.title: Recent Requests
recent_requests.body: The last 10 requests through the proxy — timing, tokens, and savings. Click a row to expand transforms.

time.title: Time
time.body: When the request was received by the proxy.

input.title: Input
input.body: Input tokens sent upstream after compression for this request.

output.title: Output
output.body: Tokens the model generated in the response.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Percentage of input tokens compression removed on this request.

latency.title: Latency
latency.body: Total round-trip time for this request, including proxy overhead and upstream response.

original_tokens.title: Original Tokens
original_tokens.body: Input tokens as they arrived, before the proxy compressed this request.

compressed_tokens.title: Compressed Tokens
compressed_tokens.body: Input tokens actually forwarded upstream after compression.

tokens_removed.title: Tokens Removed
tokens_removed.body: Original Tokens minus Compressed Tokens for this request.

optimization_time.title: Optimization Time
optimization_time.body: Time the proxy spent compressing this request before forwarding it upstream.

transforms_applied.title: Transforms Applied
transforms_applied.body: The compression transforms Headroom ran on this request, in order.

waste_detected.title: Waste Detected
waste_detected.body: Which kinds of prompt waste (bloated tool output, repeated listings, minifiable JSON, etc.) were found in this specific request, and how many tokens each accounted for.

transformation_detail.title: Transformation detail
transformation_detail.body: Click this card to open a larger, unclipped view of the before/after content.

request.title: Request
request.body: The model this request was routed to, tokens Headroom removed, and the resulting savings percentage.

time_2.title: Time
time_2.body: When the proxy handled this request.

before.title: Before
before.body: The original prompt exactly as sent to Headroom, before any compression.

after.title: After
after.body: What Headroom actually sent upstream to the provider after compression.

transforms_applied_2.title: Transforms applied
transforms_applied_2.body: The compression transforms Headroom ran on this request, in order.

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.body: This request passed through Headroom byte-identical -- the input and output are the same, nothing was compressed. Click the card for the full content.

per_project.title: Per-Project
per_project.body: Lifetime savings attributed to each project, for clients routed through /p/<project-name>.

project.title: Project
project.body: Project name from the /p/<project-name> route the client used.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: Attributed requests routed for this project.

tokens_saved.title: Tokens Saved
tokens_saved.body: Lifetime input tokens the proxy compressed away for this project.

saved.title: Saved $
saved.body: Estimated dollars saved from compression for this project, at the model's list input rate.

savings.title: Savings %
savings.body: Tokens saved as a percentage of this project's before-compression input.

last_active.title: Last Active
last_active.body: Timestamp of the most recent request attributed to this project.

waste_trends.title: Waste & Trends
waste_trends.body: What kinds of prompt waste the proxy removed, and cumulative token savings over time.

what_headroom_removed.title: What Headroom Removed
what_headroom_removed.body: Breakdown of which kinds of prompt waste the proxy compressed away (verbose tool output, redundant file listings, minifiable JSON, etc.), by tokens removed.

savings_over_time.title: Savings Over Time
savings_over_time.body: Cumulative tokens saved across recent requests in this session, plotted as a running total.

active_agents.title: Active Agents
active_agents.body: Agents that sent requests through the proxy in the last minute, derived from completed request logs (not live connections). Traffic through the proxy shows up here.

project.title: Project
project.body: The /p/<project-name> tag this agent's requests were routed under, if any.

last_active.title: Last active
last_active.body: Seconds since this agent's most recent request completed. Agents drop off this list after 60s of inactivity.

requests_tokens_saved.title: Requests / Tokens Saved
requests_tokens_saved.body: Requests this agent sent, and cumulative input tokens compression removed for them, within the last-minute window.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.body: Local install profiles on this host, recent headroom learn runs, and memory-sync dedup stats — useful when debugging a specific deployment.

local_install_profiles.title: Local install profiles
local_install_profiles.body: Install profiles recorded by `headroom install` on this host. Not a multi-host fleet or remote deployments — local only.

learn_history.title: Learn history
learn_history.body: Recent `headroom learn` runs recorded on this host: when they ran, which agent/project, how many recommendations, and whether they were applied.

memory_sync.title: Memory sync
memory_sync.body: Per-agent memory import/export counts and dedup rate from the last sync, sourced from /debug/memory/sync.

run_learn.title: Run learn --apply
run_learn.body: Starts `headroom learn --apply` as a detached background job to analyze recent sessions and persist new compression recommendations. Runs in the background; refresh Learn history below later to see the result.

export_json.title: Export JSON
export_json.body: Download the currently selected series (granularity and range) as a JSON file for offline analysis.

export_csv.title: Export CSV
export_csv.body: Download the currently selected series (granularity and range) as a CSV file for spreadsheets.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Headline historical totals: lifetime savings, average tokens saved per day/week.

lifetime_compression_savings.title: Lifetime Compression Savings
lifetime_compression_savings.body: Total money saved by compression across every session since Headroom was installed, persisted to disk.

lifetime_tokens_saved.title: Lifetime Tokens Saved
lifetime_tokens_saved.body: Total input tokens removed by compression across all sessions since install.

active_days.title: Active Days
active_days.body: Number of distinct days on which at least one request flowed through the proxy.

average_saved_day.title: Average Saved / Day
average_saved_day.body: Lifetime tokens saved divided by the number of persisted daily buckets — a rough per-day average, not a rolling window.

average_saved_week.title: Average Saved / Week
average_saved_week.body: Lifetime tokens saved divided by the number of persisted weekly buckets — a rough per-week average, not a rolling window.

trends.title: Trends
trends.body: Historical savings trend chart, per-model breakdown, daily/weekly/monthly rollups, and recent checkpoints.

granularity.title: Granularity
granularity.body: Which persisted rollup bucket to chart: raw checkpoints, or daily/weekly/monthly cumulative sums.

chart_mode.title: Chart mode
chart_mode.body: Switch the trend chart between cumulative tokens saved and actual-vs-expected dollar cost.

model.title: Model
model.body: Model identifier attributed to this row's traffic, from per-model attribution recorded in persisted checkpoints.

tokens_saved.title: Tokens saved
tokens_saved.body: Cumulative input tokens removed by compression for this model, summed across the selected series.

cost_with_headroom.title: Cost with Headroom
cost_with_headroom.body: Actual billed input cost for this model's compressed traffic, at list input price.

expected_cost_without_headroom.title: Expected cost (without Headroom)
expected_cost_without_headroom.body: What this model's traffic would have cost at list input price if Headroom hadn't removed any tokens: actual billed cost + estimated compression savings. Assumes the same requests would have been sent uncompressed and that list pricing is current.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Dollar savings for this model: expected cost without Headroom minus actual cost with Headroom.

latest_total.title: Latest total
latest_total.body: Lifetime tokens saved as of the most recent persisted checkpoint, independent of the granularity currently selected above.

selected_series.title: Selected series
selected_series.body: Which persisted rollup the chart and stats above are currently reading from (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or raw Checkpoints).

selected_points.title: Selected points
selected_points.body: Number of data points in the currently selected series.

average_month.title: Average / month
average_month.body: Lifetime tokens saved divided by the number of persisted monthly buckets.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: How much persisted history is kept on disk before old checkpoints are pruned: max age in days / max number of checkpoints, whichever limit is hit first.

daily_savings.title: Daily Savings
daily_savings.body: Last 7 persisted daily buckets: tokens saved that day plus the running cumulative total, most recent first.

weekly_savings.title: Weekly Savings
weekly_savings.body: Last 6 persisted weekly buckets: tokens saved that week plus the running cumulative total, most recent first.

monthly_savings.title: Monthly Savings
monthly_savings.body: Last 6 persisted monthly buckets: tokens saved that month plus the running cumulative total, most recent first.

recent_historical_checkpoints.title: Recent Historical Checkpoints
recent_historical_checkpoints.body: Last 8 raw persisted checkpoints (not rolled up), each with the cumulative tokens and dollars saved at that point in time.

mcp_usage.title: MCP Usage
mcp_usage.body: Counts of mcp__<server>__<tool> calls seen in requests that flowed through the proxy. Requires full-message logging to be enabled.

calls_by_tool.title: Calls by tool
calls_by_tool.body: Number of invocations of each individual tool exposed by this MCP server.

ccr_feedback.title: CCR Feedback
ccr_feedback.body: The reversible-compression trust signal: how often a compressed tool result later needed to be retrieved in full. A high retrieval rate for a tool means compression may be too lossy for it — the feedback loop should ease off.

tool.title: Tool
tool.body: MCP tool whose results Headroom has compressed and tracked for later retrieval.

compressions.title: Compressions
compressions.body: Number of times this tool's result was compressed by the reversible-compression (CCR) path.

retrievals.title: Retrievals
retrievals.body: Number of times a compressed result for this tool was later fetched back in full via the retrieval mechanism.

retrieval_rate.title: Retrieval rate
retrieval_rate.body: Retrievals divided by compressions for this tool. Above 20% (highlighted) suggests compression is discarding information this tool's callers actually need.

full_retrieval_rate.title: Full retrieval rate
full_retrieval_rate.body: Share of this tool's compressed results that were retrieved in full at least once, over the tool's entire recorded history (not just the current page window).

total_compressions.title: Total compressions
total_compressions.body: Lifetime count of this tool's results compressed by the CCR path.

total_retrievals.title: Total retrievals
total_retrievals.body: Lifetime count of full-content retrievals for this tool's compressed results.

common_queries.title: Common queries
common_queries.body: Most frequent retrieval queries issued against this tool's compressed results — recurring lookups hint at what compression is stripping out that callers keep needing back.

mcp_dashboards.title: MCP Dashboards
mcp_dashboards.body: Expand a dashboard to try loading its live UI in an embedded frame (lazy — nothing loads until you expand). If it can't be embedded (blocked, slow, or no native fallback exists for that MCP), a link to open it in a new tab is shown instead.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.body: Raw endpoints for scraping Headroom metrics into your own tooling, plus quick exports of the last 30 days of savings history.

logging_on.title: Logging on
logging_on.body: Full-message logging is enabled, so MCP tool calls in request bodies are being counted.

logging_off.title: Log-messages off
logging_off.body: Full-message logging is off, so MCP tool calls cannot be detected. Start the proxy with --log-messages to enable this.

server_row.title: MCP server
server_row.body: {value} total tool calls through this MCP server. Click to see the per-tool breakdown.

stats_poll_ms.title: Stats poll (ms)
stats_poll_ms.body: How often the browser polls /stats for the hero metrics, throughput, and health. Lower values feel more live but add request overhead.

history_poll_ms.title: History poll (ms)
history_poll_ms.body: How often the browser re-fetches persisted savings history while the Historical tab is open.

feed_poll_ms.title: Feed poll (ms)
feed_poll_ms.body: How often the Live Feed drawer re-fetches recent transformation events while it's open. Has no effect when the drawer is closed.

savings_profile.title: Savings profile
savings_profile.body: Named preset controlling how aggressively prompts are compressed. Blank uses the built-in default profile.

target_ratio_0_1.title: Target ratio (0-1)
target_ratio_0_1.body: Desired fraction of input tokens kept after compression, e.g. 0.6 aims to keep ~60% (remove ~40%). Lower values compress more aggressively.

budget_limit_usd.title: Budget limit (USD)
budget_limit_usd.body: Spend ceiling for the configured budget period. Crossing 80/90/100% of this limit triggers the near-limit warning banner. Leave 0 or blank for no limit.

budget_period.title: Budget period
budget_period.body: The window the budget limit resets over: hourly, daily, or monthly. Determines when period_spend_usd resets to zero.

model.title: Model
model.body: Model identifier to override, matched against the model name reported in requests (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5).

input.title: Input
input.body: USD per 1M input tokens. Overrides the LiteLLM list price used to estimate cost and savings for this model.

output.title: Output
output.body: USD per 1M output tokens. Overrides the LiteLLM list price used to estimate cost for this model's responses.

c_read.title: C.Read
c_read.body: USD per 1M cache-read tokens — the discounted rate charged when a request hits the provider's prompt cache.

c_write.title: C.Write
c_write.body: USD per 1M cache-write tokens — the rate charged to populate the provider's prompt cache on a cache miss.

panes.title: Panes
panes.body: Show or hide individual collapsible sections within the Session and Historical tabs. Unchecking a pane here removes it from the layout entirely, rather than just collapsing it.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.body: Show or hide entire top-level tabs (Session, Historical, MCP). Hidden tabs are not rendered until re-enabled here.

status_uptime_cluster.title: Status & uptime cluster
status_uptime_cluster.body: Toggle the health/updated/uptime indicators shown in the top-left of the header next to the Headroom title.

mcp_dashboards_button.title: MCP Dashboards button
mcp_dashboards_button.body: Toggle the 'MCP Dashboards' button in the header that links out to detected MCP servers' own web UIs.

near_limit_notifications.title: Near-Limit Notifications
near_limit_notifications.body: When enabled, fires a native OS notification the first time a budget or provider quota window crosses 80/90/100% utilization (same text as the in-page banner). Client-local preference, not saved to the proxy config.

savings_formula.title: savings formula
savings_formula.body: tokens_saved is the count of input tokens Headroom removed before the request left the proxy, directly measured (not estimated). List input price is looked up per-model from the pricing table below, or your Settings override if one is set.

litellm.title: LiteLLM
litellm.body: An open-source Python library Headroom depends on for its bundled, community-maintained table of per-model input/output/cache token prices.

estimated.title: estimated
estimated.body: This badge appears next to every dollar figure on the dashboard: it's priced from the pricing table (LiteLLM or your Settings override) and can drift if that table is stale. Token counts shown nearby are measured directly and never carry this badge.

follow_on.title: Follow
follow_on.body: Follow is on: the feed auto-scrolls to the newest message as new ones arrive. Click to pause and scroll freely.

follow_off.title: Follow
follow_off.body: Follow is off. Click to jump to the newest message and resume auto-scrolling.
